press_references.value: Backflip AI Launches CAD Copilot That Transforms 3D Scans Into Engineer-Quality, Editable CAD Models

product_launches.description: Backflip AI launched its CAD Copilot, an AI service that converts 3D scans, STL files, and mesh data into editable, parametric CAD models. It is available through an Autodesk Fusion add-in and a standalone web app.
The 3D AI foundation model and tools enable automatic conversion of 3D scan data into CAD files, reducing manufacturing downtime.

overview_description.description:
Backflip AI is 3D generative AI for the real world allows engineers and designers to work at their own pace and creative constraints.

Anyone may use its AI-powered 3D design tools to realize their ideas and produce incredibly realistic models that can be printed out or used as video game assets, 3D renders, and other digital media.
